findings.description: A boxed neon sign rendered at a size and brightness comparable to the adjacent 'OPEN' sign reads as '▮IO' (red bar fragment, 'I', 'O') — not a word or plausible sign text. The reading is identical across all dusk wide shots (00:19-00:45), so it is not motion blur; the window mullion does not cover enough of the box to explain the missing letters. Appears to be a garbled AI-rendered neon sign.
